title: TallyPrime vs Zoho Books for Indian Businesses
verdict: Stay with TallyPrime if your accountant and team rely on it and inventory is central. Choose Zoho Books if you work remotely, already use Zoho apps, or need modern APIs for integrations.
seoTitle: TallyPrime vs Zoho Books: Which Suits Your Business?
seoDescription: TallyPrime or Zoho Books for Indian accounting: GST, e-invoicing, inventory, cloud access, integrations, CA familiarity and cost of ownership compared.
summary: TallyPrime is the accounting software most Indian accountants know, strong in GST, inventory and offline speed, installed on your computers with remote access options. Zoho Books is cloud-first, with easy remote access, clean APIs and tight links to other Zoho apps. Tally suits traditional, inventory-heavy businesses; Zoho Books suits cloud-first teams that integrate many tools.

dataPoints.label: Deployment
dataPoints.value: TallyPrime: installed locally, remote access via Tally tools or cloud hosting. Zoho Books: cloud

dataPoints.label: GST and e-invoicing
dataPoints.value: Both support GST returns and e-invoicing for eligible businesses

dataPoints.label: Inventory
dataPoints.value: TallyPrime: mature inventory and batches. Zoho Books: basic, with Zoho Inventory for more

dataPoints.label: Integrations
dataPoints.value: TallyPrime: XML/ODBC interfaces and TDL. Zoho Books: REST API and native Zoho integrations

dataPoints.label: Accountant familiarity
dataPoints.value: TallyPrime is widely known by Indian CAs and accountants

dataPoints.label: Licensing
dataPoints.value: TallyPrime: licence per edition with renewals. Zoho Books: subscription by plan

body:
## Integration matters most

If you want orders, payments and CRM data to flow into accounts automatically, check the integration path first. Tally integrations usually need a connector on the Tally machine; Zoho Books integrates through cloud APIs. See our [Tally integration guides](/integrations).

## Switching

Moving accounting systems is best done at the start of a financial year, with opening balances verified by your CA. See [planning technology projects around the Indian financial year](/blog/planning-technology-projects-around-the-indian-financial-year).

Prices and plan features change often; check the vendors' current Indian pricing before deciding.

faqs.q: Can my CA work with Zoho Books?
faqs.a: Yes, with accountant access; some CAs prefer Tally, so ask before switching.

faqs.q: Is Tally available on the cloud?
faqs.a: Tally can run on cloud servers or be accessed remotely; it is not a browser-native cloud app in the way Zoho Books is.
